script:
ticket_id = doc.custom_service_ticket

if ticket_id:
    try:
        ticket = frappe.get_doc("Service Ticket", ticket_id)

        # Always update commercial status when quotation is submitted
        ticket.custom_commercial_status = "Quote Sent"
        ticket.custom_requires_parts = doc.custom_requires_parts or 0

        # Only pause technical ticket if work is not already done
        if ticket.custom_ticket_status not in ["Resolved", "Closed"]:
            ticket.custom_ticket_status = "On Hold"
            ticket.custom_hold_reason = "Awaiting Quote Approval"

        exists = False

        for row in ticket.get("custom_commercial_references") or []:
            if row.custom_reference_type == "Quotation" and row.custom_reference_name == doc.name:
                exists = True
                row.custom_status = doc.status
                row.custom_amount = doc.grand_total or 0
                row.custom_posting_date = doc.transaction_date
                row.custom_remarks = "Quotation submitted"

        if not exists:
            ticket.append("custom_commercial_references", {
                "custom_reference_type": "Quotation",
                "custom_reference_name": doc.name,
                "custom_status": doc.status,
                "custom_amount": doc.grand_total or 0,
                "custom_posting_date": doc.transaction_date,
                "custom_remarks": "Quotation submitted"
            })

        ticket.save(ignore_permissions=True)

    except Exception as e:
        frappe.log_error(str(e), "Quotation Service Ticket Sync Failed")

script:
# =========================
# ASSET SERVICE LOG
# =========================

existing_service_log = frappe.db.exists(
    "Asset Service Log",
    {
        "custom_intervention_ref": doc.name
    }
)

if not existing_service_log:

    service_log = frappe.new_doc("Asset Service Log")

    service_log.custom_customer = doc.custom_parent_customer
    service_log.custom_branch = doc.custom_branch
    service_log.custom_related_asset = doc.custom_asset

    service_log.custom_component_group = doc.get("custom_component_group")
    service_log.custom_component_item = doc.get("custom_component_item")
    service_log.custom_component_row_id = doc.get("custom_component_row_id")
    service_log.custom_component_serial = doc.get("custom_component_serial")
    service_log.custom_component_brand = doc.get("custom_component_brand")
    service_log.custom_component_model = doc.get("custom_component_model")

    service_log.custom_intervention_type = doc.custom_intervention_type or "Service"
    service_log.custom_technician = doc.custom_technician or frappe.session.user
    service_log.custom_work_outcome = doc.custom_work_outcome
    service_log.custom_notes = doc.custom_work_progress or doc.custom_description or ""

    service_log.custom_service_ticket = doc.custom_service_ticket
    service_log.custom_mission_ref = doc.custom_parent_mission
    service_log.custom_intervention_ref = doc.name

    service_log.custom_service_date = doc.custom_start_time
    service_log.custom_end_time = doc.custom_end_time
    service_log.custom_duration = doc.custom_hours_worked or 0

    service_log.insert(ignore_permissions=True)

    if service_log.docstatus == 0:
        service_log.submit()


# =========================
# CONFIG UPDATE LOG
# =========================

for row in doc.get("custom_config_changes") or []:

    if not row.get("custom_parameter") and not row.get("custom_new_value"):
        continue

    existing_config_log = frappe.db.exists(
        "Config Update Log",
        {
            "custom_service_ticket": doc.custom_service_ticket,
            "custom_parameter": row.get("custom_parameter"),
            "custom_new_value": row.get("custom_new_value")
        }
    )

    if existing_config_log:
        continue

    config_log = frappe.new_doc("Config Update Log")

    config_log.custom_customer = doc.custom_parent_customer
    config_log.custom_branch = doc.custom_branch
    config_log.custom_technician = doc.custom_technician or frappe.session.user
    config_log.custom_related_asset = doc.custom_asset
    config_log.custom_notes = row.get("custom_notes") or doc.custom_work_progress or ""

    config_log.custom_parameter = row.get("custom_parameter")
    config_log.custom_current_value = row.get("custom_current_value")
    config_log.custom_new_value = row.get("custom_new_value")

    config_log.custom_service_ticket = doc.custom_service_ticket
    config_log.custom_intervention = doc.name
    config_log.custom_datetime = row.get("custom_config_datetime") or frappe.utils.now_datetime()

    config_log.insert(ignore_permissions=True)

    if config_log.docstatus == 0:
        config_log.submit()


# =========================
# ASSET LIFECYCLE LOG
# Whole-equipment lifecycle / movement events
# Uses custom_swap_classification as the official lifecycle event.
# =========================

lifecycle_event = doc.get("custom_swap_classification")

# Backward compatibility if older MIs still rely on Intervention Type only.
if not lifecycle_event:
    if doc.get("custom_intervention_type") == "Asset Relocation":
        lifecycle_event = "Relocated"
    elif doc.get("custom_intervention_type") == "Swap":
        lifecycle_event = "Permanent Swap"
    elif doc.get("custom_intervention_type") == "Loan":
        if str(doc.get("custom_loan_return") or "0") == "1":
            lifecycle_event = "Loan Returned"
        else:
            lifecycle_event = "Loan Issued"
    elif doc.get("custom_intervention_type") == "Retirement":
        lifecycle_event = "Retired"
    elif doc.get("custom_intervention_type") == "Disposal":
        lifecycle_event = "Disposed"
    elif doc.get("custom_intervention_type") == "Installation":
        lifecycle_event = "Installed"
    elif doc.get("custom_intervention_type") == "Commissioning":
        lifecycle_event = "Commissioned"


valid_lifecycle_events = [
    "Commissioned",
    "Installed",
    "Relocated",
    "Loan Issued",
    "Loan Returned",
    "Sent For Repair",
    "Returned From Repair",
    "Retired",
    "Disposed",
    "Permanent Swap"
]

if lifecycle_event and lifecycle_event in valid_lifecycle_events:

    if not doc.get("custom_asset"):
        frappe.throw("Equipment is required for lifecycle update.")

    asset_values = frappe.db.get_value(
        "Installed Equipment",
        doc.custom_asset,
        [
            "custom_make",
            "custom_model",
            "custom_branch",
            "custom_asset_id",
            "custom_asset_status"
        ],
        as_dict=True
    )

    previous_make = doc.get("custom_previous_make")
    previous_model = doc.get("custom_previous_model")
    previous_branch = doc.get("custom_previous_branch")
    previous_serial = doc.get("custom_previous_serial")

    if asset_values:
        previous_make = previous_make or asset_values.custom_make
        previous_model = previous_model or asset_values.custom_model
        previous_branch = previous_branch or asset_values.custom_branch
        previous_serial = previous_serial or asset_values.custom_asset_id

    new_asset_values = None

    if doc.get("custom_new_asset"):
        new_asset_values = frappe.db.get_value(
            "Installed Equipment",
            doc.custom_new_asset,
            [
                "custom_make",
                "custom_model",
                "custom_branch",
                "custom_asset_id",
                "custom_asset_status"
            ],
            as_dict=True
        )

    new_make = doc.get("custom_new_make")
    new_model = doc.get("custom_new_model")
    new_branch = doc.get("custom_new_branch")
    new_serial = doc.get("custom_new_serial")

    if new_asset_values:
        new_make = new_make or new_asset_values.custom_make
        new_model = new_model or new_asset_values.custom_model
        new_serial = new_serial or new_asset_values.custom_asset_id

    if lifecycle_event in [
        "Installed",
        "Relocated",
        "Loan Issued",
        "Loan Returned",
        "Returned From Repair",
        "Permanent Swap"
    ] and not new_branch:
        new_branch = doc.get("custom_branch") or previous_branch

    existing_lifecycle = frappe.db.exists(
        "Asset Lifecycle Log",
        {
            "custom_intervention_ref": doc.name,
            "custom_event": lifecycle_event
        }
    )

    if not existing_lifecycle:

        lifecycle_log = frappe.new_doc("Asset Lifecycle Log")

        lifecycle_log.custom_customer = doc.custom_parent_customer
        lifecycle_log.custom_branch = doc.custom_branch
        lifecycle_log.custom_related_asset = doc.custom_asset
        lifecycle_log.custom_date = doc.custom_start_time or frappe.utils.now_datetime()

        lifecycle_log.custom_event = lifecycle_event

        if lifecycle_log.meta.has_field("custom_swap_classification"):
            lifecycle_log.custom_swap_classification = lifecycle_event

        lifecycle_log.custom_previous_make = previous_make
        lifecycle_log.custom_previous_model = previous_model
        lifecycle_log.custom_previous_serial = previous_serial
        lifecycle_log.custom_previous_branch = previous_branch

        lifecycle_log.custom_new_make = new_make
        lifecycle_log.custom_new_model = new_model
        lifecycle_log.custom_new_serial = new_serial
        lifecycle_log.custom_new_branch = new_branch

        if lifecycle_log.meta.has_field("custom_new_asset"):
            lifecycle_log.custom_new_asset = doc.get("custom_new_asset")

        if lifecycle_log.meta.has_field("custom_asset_change_reason"):
            lifecycle_log.custom_asset_change_reason = doc.get("custom_asset_change_reason")

        lifecycle_log.custom_event_source = "Intervention"

        lifecycle_log.custom_action_taken = (
            doc.get("custom_asset_change_reason")
            or doc.get("custom_work_progress")
            or doc.get("custom_description")
            or lifecycle_event
        )

        lifecycle_log.custom_technician = doc.custom_technician or frappe.session.user
        lifecycle_log.custom_service_ticket = doc.custom_service_ticket
        lifecycle_log.custom_mission_ref = doc.custom_parent_mission
        lifecycle_log.custom_intervention_ref = doc.name

        lifecycle_log.insert(ignore_permissions=True)

        if lifecycle_log.docstatus == 0:
            lifecycle_log.submit()

    # =========================
    # UPDATE INSTALLED EQUIPMENT STATUS / BRANCH
    # =========================

    current_asset_updates = {}

    if lifecycle_event == "Relocated":
        current_asset_updates["custom_asset_status"] = "Installed"
        if new_branch:
            current_asset_updates["custom_branch"] = new_branch

    elif lifecycle_event == "Sent For Repair":
        current_asset_updates["custom_asset_status"] = "In Workshop"

    elif lifecycle_event == "Returned From Repair":
        current_asset_updates["custom_asset_status"] = "Installed"
        if new_branch:
            current_asset_updates["custom_branch"] = new_branch

    elif lifecycle_event == "Retired":
        current_asset_updates["custom_asset_status"] = "Retired"

    elif lifecycle_event == "Disposed":
        current_asset_updates["custom_asset_status"] = "Scrapped"

    elif lifecycle_event == "Permanent Swap":
        current_asset_updates["custom_asset_status"] = "Retired"

    elif lifecycle_event == "Loan Issued":
        current_asset_updates["custom_asset_status"] = "Under Repair"

    elif lifecycle_event == "Loan Returned":
        current_asset_updates["custom_asset_status"] = "Installed"
        if new_branch:
            current_asset_updates["custom_branch"] = new_branch

    elif lifecycle_event in ["Commissioned", "Installed"]:
        current_asset_updates["custom_asset_status"] = "Installed"
        if new_branch:
            current_asset_updates["custom_branch"] = new_branch

    if current_asset_updates:
        frappe.db.set_value(
            "Installed Equipment",
            doc.custom_asset,
            current_asset_updates
        )

    if doc.get("custom_new_asset"):

        new_asset_updates = {}

        if lifecycle_event == "Permanent Swap":
            new_asset_updates["custom_asset_status"] = "Installed"
            if new_branch:
                new_asset_updates["custom_branch"] = new_branch

        elif lifecycle_event == "Loan Issued":
            new_asset_updates["custom_asset_status"] = "Loaned"
            if new_branch:
                new_asset_updates["custom_branch"] = new_branch

        elif lifecycle_event == "Loan Returned":
            new_asset_updates["custom_asset_status"] = "Returned"

        elif lifecycle_event in ["Commissioned", "Installed"]:
            new_asset_updates["custom_asset_status"] = "Installed"
            if new_branch:
                new_asset_updates["custom_branch"] = new_branch

        if new_asset_updates:
            frappe.db.set_value(
                "Installed Equipment",
                doc.custom_new_asset,
                new_asset_updates
            )




# =========================
# COMPONENT REPLACEMENT
# Only runs when Component Replaced? is checked
# =========================

component_replacement_requested = (
    str(doc.get("custom_component_replaced") or "0") == "1"
    and doc.get("custom_new_component_item")
)

if component_replacement_requested:

    if not doc.get("custom_asset"):
        frappe.throw("Equipment is required for component replacement.")

    if not doc.get("custom_component_row_id"):
        frappe.throw("Original component row is required.")

    if not doc.get("custom_new_component_item"):
        frappe.throw("New Component Item is required.")

    def clean_component_item_code(value):
        item_code = value

        if item_code and not frappe.db.exists("Item", item_code):
            if " - SN:" in item_code:
                item_code = item_code.split(" - SN:")[0].strip()
            elif " - SN" in item_code:
                item_code = item_code.split(" - SN")[0].strip()
            elif " - " in item_code:
                item_code = item_code.split(" - ")[0].strip()

        return item_code

    new_component_item = clean_component_item_code(
        doc.get("custom_new_component_item")
    )

    if not new_component_item or not frappe.db.exists("Item", new_component_item):
        frappe.throw(
            "New Component Item is not a valid Item: "
            + str(doc.get("custom_new_component_item"))
        )

    equipment = frappe.get_doc("Installed Equipment", doc.custom_asset)

    old_row = None

    for row in equipment.get("custom_installed_components") or []:
        if row.name == doc.get("custom_component_row_id"):
            old_row = row
            break

    if not old_row:
        frappe.throw("Original component row not found on Installed Equipment.")

    old_row.custom_status = "Replaced"

    equipment.append("custom_installed_components", {
        "custom_component_item": new_component_item,
        "custom_item_group": old_row.get("custom_item_group"),
        "custom_item_name": new_component_item,
        "custom_serial_number": doc.get("custom_new_component_serial"),
        "custom_brand": doc.get("custom_new_component_brand"),
        "custom_model": doc.get("custom_new_component_model"),
        "custom_status": "Installed",
        "custom_notes": (
            doc.get("custom_component_replacement_reason")
            or ("Installed from MI " + doc.name)
        )
    })

    # Defensive cleanup:
    # Older/test rows may already contain display labels like
    # "Coupling - SN: 123 - Brand - Model" inside the Link field.
    # equipment.save() validates every child row, so clean all rows first.
    for comp_row in equipment.get("custom_installed_components") or []:
        item_value = comp_row.get("custom_component_item")
        clean_item = clean_component_item_code(item_value)

        if clean_item and frappe.db.exists("Item", clean_item):
            comp_row.custom_component_item = clean_item
        elif item_value:
            frappe.throw(
                "Invalid component item in Installed Equipment row: "
                + str(item_value)
            )

    equipment.save(ignore_permissions=True)

    existing_component_lifecycle = frappe.db.exists(
        "Asset Lifecycle Log",
        {
            "custom_intervention_ref": doc.name,
            "custom_event": "Component Replaced"
        }
    )

    if not existing_component_lifecycle:

        lifecycle_log = frappe.new_doc("Asset Lifecycle Log")

        lifecycle_log.custom_customer = doc.custom_parent_customer
        lifecycle_log.custom_branch = doc.custom_branch
        lifecycle_log.custom_related_asset = doc.custom_asset
        lifecycle_log.custom_date = doc.custom_start_time or frappe.utils.now_datetime()
        lifecycle_log.custom_event = "Component Replaced"
        lifecycle_log.custom_event_source = "Intervention"
        lifecycle_log.custom_action_taken = (
            doc.get("custom_component_replacement_reason")
            or "Component Replaced"
        )

        lifecycle_log.custom_technician = doc.custom_technician or frappe.session.user
        lifecycle_log.custom_service_ticket = doc.custom_service_ticket
        lifecycle_log.custom_mission_ref = doc.custom_parent_mission
        lifecycle_log.custom_intervention_ref = doc.name

        lifecycle_log.custom_component_item = clean_component_item_code(
            doc.get("custom_component_item")
        )
        lifecycle_log.custom_component_serial = doc.get("custom_component_serial")
        lifecycle_log.custom_component_brand = doc.get("custom_component_brand")
        lifecycle_log.custom_component_model = doc.get("custom_component_model")

        lifecycle_log.custom_new_component_item = new_component_item
        lifecycle_log.custom_new_component_serial = doc.get("custom_new_component_serial")
        lifecycle_log.custom_new_component_brand = doc.get("custom_new_component_brand")
        lifecycle_log.custom_new_component_model = doc.get("custom_new_component_model")

        lifecycle_log.insert(ignore_permissions=True)

        if lifecycle_log.docstatus == 0:
            lifecycle_log.submit()


# =========================
# UPDATE LAST SERVICE DATE
# =========================

if (
    doc.get("custom_asset")
    and doc.get("custom_intervention_type") in [
        "Service",
        "Preventive Maintenance",
        "Calibration"
    ]
    and (
        doc.get("custom_work_outcome") == "Work Completed"
        or doc.get("custom_completed_time")
        or doc.get("custom_end_time")
    )
):
    frappe.db.set_value(
        "Installed Equipment",
        doc.custom_asset,
        "custom_last_service_date",
        (
            doc.get("custom_end_time")
            or doc.get("custom_start_time")
            or frappe.utils.now_datetime()
        )
    )


# =========================
# PUSH MI PARTS + INTERVENTION HISTORY TO SERVICE TICKET
# =========================

if doc.get("custom_service_ticket"):

    ticket = frappe.get_doc("Service Ticket", doc.custom_service_ticket)
    ticket_changed = False

    for part in doc.get("custom_parts_table") or []:

        if not part.get("custom_item_code"):
            continue

        part_exists = False

        for row in ticket.get("custom_used_parts") or []:
            if (
                row.get("custom_mission_intervention") == doc.name
                and row.get("custom_item_code") == part.get("custom_item_code")
                and row.get("custom_warehouse") == part.get("custom_warehouse")
            ):
                part_exists = True
                break

        if part_exists:
            continue

        ticket.append("custom_used_parts", {
            "custom_item_code": part.get("custom_item_code"),
            "custom_item_name": part.get("custom_item_name"),
            "custom_brand": part.get("custom_brand"),
            "custom_qty": part.get("custom_qty") or 1,
            "custom_warehouse": part.get("custom_warehouse"),
            "custom_mission_intervention": doc.name,
            "custom_billed": 0
        })

        ticket_changed = True

    history_exists = False

    for row in ticket.get("custom_intervention_history") or []:
        if row.get("custom_mission_intervention") == doc.name:
            history_exists = True
            break

    if not history_exists:
        ticket.append("custom_intervention_history", {
            "custom_mission_intervention": doc.name,
            "custom_equipment": doc.get("custom_asset"),
            "custom_work_outcome": doc.get("custom_work_outcome"),
            "custom_start_time": doc.get("custom_start_time"),
            "custom_end_time": doc.get("custom_end_time"),
            "custom_technician": doc.get("custom_technician"),
            "custom_source": "Mission Intervention",
            "custom_component_item": doc.get("custom_component_item")
        })

        ticket_changed = True

    if ticket_changed:
        ticket.save(ignore_permissions=True)


# =========================
# UPDATE MISSION + TICKET STATUS
# =========================

if doc.get("custom_parent_mission"):

    mission = frappe.get_doc("Tech Mission", doc.custom_parent_mission)
    outcome = doc.get("custom_work_outcome")

    mission.custom_mission_status = (
        "Completed" if outcome == "Work Completed" else "Ongoing"
    )

    # =========================
    # ADD MI TO TECH MISSION DAILY WORK LOGS
    # =========================

    if mission.meta.has_field("custom_intervention_table"):

        log_exists = False

        for row in mission.get("custom_intervention_table") or []:
            if row.get("custom_intervention_reference") == doc.name:
                log_exists = True
                break

        mi_status_map = {
            "Work Completed": "Completed",
            "Continue Work": "In Progress",
            "Waiting for Parts": "Waiting Parts",
            "Waiting for Client": "Waiting Client",
            "Could Not Complete": "In Progress",
            "To Quote (Billable)": "Completed"
        }

        daily_log_status = mi_status_map.get(
            doc.get("custom_work_outcome"),
            "Completed"
        )

        # =========================
        # CALCULATE MI BILLABLE HOURS
        # =========================

        physical_hours = doc.get("custom_hours_worked") or 0
        tech_count = len(mission.get("custom_planned_team") or []) or 1

        billable_hours = physical_hours

        if mission.get("custom_count_each_technician"):
            billable_hours = physical_hours * tech_count

        billable_hours = round(billable_hours, 2)

        if doc.meta.has_field("custom_billable_hours"):
            doc.db_set("custom_billable_hours", billable_hours)

        if not log_exists:
            mission.append("custom_intervention_table", {
                "custom_date": doc.get("custom_end_time") or doc.get("custom_start_time"),
                "custom_intervention_reference": doc.name,
                "custom_technician": doc.get("custom_technician"),
                "custom_hours": physical_hours,
                "custom_status": daily_log_status,
                "custom_technician_count": tech_count,
                "custom_billable_hours": billable_hours,
                "custom_work_progress": doc.get("custom_work_progress")
            })

        # =========================
        # UPDATE TECH MISSION TOTALS
        # =========================

        total_actual_hours = 0

        for row in mission.get("custom_intervention_table") or []:
            total_actual_hours += row.get("custom_billable_hours") or 0

        if mission.meta.has_field("custom_total_actual_hours"):
            mission.custom_total_actual_hours = round(total_actual_hours, 2)

        if (
            mission.meta.has_field("custom_total_hours")
            and mission.get("custom_planned_starttime")
            and mission.get("custom_planned_endtime")
        ):

            start = frappe.utils.get_datetime(
                mission.get("custom_planned_starttime")
            )

            end = frappe.utils.get_datetime(
                mission.get("custom_planned_endtime")
            )

            seconds = frappe.utils.time_diff_in_seconds(end, start)

            if seconds > 0:
                mission.custom_total_hours = round(seconds / 3600, 2)

    mission.save(ignore_permissions=True)

    # Close Tech Mission ToDos only when mission is really completed

    if mission.get("custom_mission_status") in ["Completed", "Closed"]:

        todos = frappe.get_all(
            "ToDo",
            filters={
                "reference_type": "Tech Mission",
                "reference_name": mission.name,
                "status": ["!=", "Closed"]
            },
            fields=["name"]
        )

        for row in todos:
            frappe.db.set_value(
                "ToDo",
                row.name,
                "status",
                "Closed"
            )

    # =========================
    # UPDATE SERVICE TICKET STATUS
    # =========================

    if mission.get("custom_service_ticket"):
        ticket = frappe.get_doc("Service Ticket", mission.custom_service_ticket)

        if outcome == "Work Completed":
            ticket.custom_ticket_status = "Resolved"
            ticket.custom_hold_reason = ""

            if ticket.meta.has_field("custom_resolution_source_mi"):
                ticket.custom_resolution_source_mi = doc.name

            if ticket.meta.has_field("custom_resolution_date"):
                ticket.custom_resolution_date = (
                    doc.get("custom_end_time")
                    or doc.get("custom_completed_time")
                    or frappe.utils.now_datetime()
                )

            if ticket.meta.has_field("custom_resolved_by"):
                ticket.custom_resolved_by = (
                    doc.get("custom_technician")
                    or frappe.session.user
                )

            if ticket.meta.has_field("custom_resolution_details"):
                ticket.custom_resolution_details = (
                    doc.get("custom_work_progress")
                    or ""
                )

        elif outcome == "Waiting for Parts":
            ticket.custom_ticket_status = "On Hold"
            ticket.custom_hold_reason = "Waiting for Parts"

        elif outcome == "Waiting for Client":
            ticket.custom_ticket_status = "On Hold"
            ticket.custom_hold_reason = "Waiting for Client"

        elif outcome == "Continue Work":
            ticket.custom_ticket_status = "On Hold"
            ticket.custom_hold_reason = "Continue Work"

        elif outcome == "Could Not Complete":
            ticket.custom_ticket_status = "On Hold"
            ticket.custom_hold_reason = "Could Not Complete"

        elif outcome == "To Quote (Billable)":
            ticket.custom_ticket_status = "On Hold"
            ticket.custom_hold_reason = "To Quote"

            if ticket.meta.has_field("custom_commercial_status"):
                ticket.custom_commercial_status = "To Quote"

        else:
            ticket.custom_ticket_status = "On Hold"
            ticket.custom_hold_reason = outcome or "Pending"

        ticket.save(ignore_permissions=True)
